intent: Provide Fleet Hub one authenticated, bounded, read-only Mission Control projection over canonical TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore owners. Preserve source uncertainty, forbid owner mutation, avoid direct Fleet database access, and expose no executor-liveness or completion authority beyond the typed owner snapshot.

gates.name: fleet-owner-ruff
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check api/routers/control_surface.py dharma_swarm/mission_control_contract.py dharma_swarm/mission_control_projection.py tests/test_control_surface_mission_control.py tests/test_fleet_hub_owner_integration.py

negative_controls.name: fleet-owner-fails-closed
negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_control_surface_mission_control.py tests/test_fleet_hub_owner_integration.py -k 'uninitialized or reject or mismatch or unauthorized or unavailable or bounded'

commit.message: feat(mission-control): expose bounded Fleet owner reads

interface_mismatches: Mission Control has an exact one-mission snapshot but no ratified complete fleet enumeration contract.
Fleet Hub must not open or copy TaskBoard or RuntimeStateStore SQLite files; the owner boundary must be injected and read-only.
Recorded attempts, leases, heartbeats, acknowledgements, and replaceable runtime receipts do not prove a live executor or external effect.
TaskBoard has no atomic expected-version mutation, so this packet exposes no Fleet command path.
honest_blockers: This local integration selection is not production topology ratification or deployment authority.
Mission enumeration may remain configured-ID bounded until a complete owner enumeration API is independently ratified.
This packet does not implement Chat authority, roster ownership, task mutation, NATS ACLs, durable Fleet SSE, or production authentication.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped owner projection commit. No TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, NATS, credential, ACL, daemon, deployment, or live owner data is mutated.
